title: Public charging – earn from your VOOL charger
description: Make your charger public in a few clicks. It appears on Google Maps, Waze and Apple Maps, and payments are collected for you.

sections.title: Your charger stands idle most of the day. Let it earn.
sections.lead: Open your VOOL charger to other drivers when it suits you. You set the price and keep the margin. For business customers.
sections.alt: VOOL charger outside an office building

items.title: Add the charger
items.text: Add your charger to the VOOL Portal.

items.title: Set the electricity price
items.text: Enter what the electricity costs you.

items.title: Set your margin
items.text: Decide what you earn on each kWh.

items.title: Make it public
items.text: Drivers can now find it and pay for charging.

sections.alt: Public chargers in the VOOL App
sections.title: Drivers find you where they already look
sections.text: A public charger shows up on Google Maps, Waze, Apple Maps, Tesla, TomTom, HERE and Chargetrip, and in the VOOL App with live availability and price.

items.title: Your price, your hours
items.text: Change pricing and availability whenever you want.

items.title: Payments handled
items.text: Drivers pay in the app. No invoices to chase.

items.title: Live overview
items.text: See status, sessions and income for every charger.

items.text: Drivers start charging with the apps and cards of other providers. You are paid the same way. Providers are being added now.
